title: Camie
subtitle: Independent
description: Living life at Anchorhead on Tatooine, Camie used to hang out with her boyfriend, Fixer, and her other friends at Tosche Station. By the time the Empire's end came about, her life had not changed much, and she and her now-husband were the victims of a Nikto biker gang. It was fortunate that they were rescued by Boba Fett, who dispatched the Niktos with cold precision.
